hero.name: Abhisek Swain
hero.intro: Backend developer at Inflexi Technologies, managing e-commerce websites end to end — products, inventory and every piece of store data — and building custom CMS platforms that let clients run their sites without touching code.

services.title: E-commerce Management
services.text: Running BigCommerce and WooCommerce stores day to day — adding, editing and removing products, keeping inventory accurate and managing all store data.

services.title: Custom CMS Development
services.text: Admin panels built around the client's content, so they can update pages, galleries, bookings and listings on their own.

services.title: Backend & APIs
services.text: Server-side logic with Node.js, Express, PHP and Laravel, backed by MySQL or MongoDB, with clean routes and data models.

services.title: Themes & Frontend
services.text: BigCommerce Stencil and WordPress theme customization, responsive layouts with Bootstrap, and graphics in Photoshop and Canva.

cta.title: Have a project in mind?
cta.text: Whether it's a store to manage or a CMS to build from scratch, drop me an email and I'll get back to you.
